comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Fixed alongside the two brace cards on the sprint board (a_25S3ICERd, a_25S2bdrTD) - it is the same grammar release, so shipping it separately would have cost a second version bump.

`esc_close_bracket` added to the escape set in grammar.js, `K_ESC_CLOSE_BRACKET` in rts/rl/consts.go, and a case in `resolveStringPart`. `print("\{ and \}")` now prints `{ and }`.

Blocked on the same tree-sitter-rad release.

creator: Alexander Terp
title: Closing brace escape \} does not work (asymmetry with \{)
